name: Clavie
source:
The Man in the Moon

The omnipotent creator of the Magicians and the MO worlds. A calm gentleman in a pristine lab coat, he watches over the happenings in the MO worlds, as if waiting for something. His smile soft and slight, Clavie's faintly aged but still young face shows tired signs of the misery he's endured.

No one knows what his origins or goals are, especially not why he created the MO worlds in the first place. Who is he, and why would he create these seemingly perfect fantasy-like worlds only to allow such suffering in them?

Follow the various heroines on their journeys to find out and put an end to this charade.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12627991.clavie]official bio[/url]]
